repositoryEligibility.publicPretrainingLimitation: Public-source eligibility establishes no project-specific exposure or tuning; it cannot prove that a foundation model never encountered public code during pretraining, and the final report must state this limitation.
repositoryEligibility.ineligibleDispositionBeforeSelectionSeal: The custodian may remove an ineligible metadata candidate and rebuild the candidate pool before Human selection; no holdout identity has yet been created.
repositoryEligibility.ineligibleDispositionAfterSelectionSeal: Any eligibility failure invalidates and permanently retires the entire selected holdout set. No repository or scenario replacement is permitted.

prohibitedSampling: randomly splitting test methods from one feature group across development and holdout
dropping unsupported, unresolved, negative, duplicate, or failed scenarios after result inspection
substituting synthetic examples for natural repository holdout evidence

measurementContract.unit: source-backed scenario to production METHOD pair

canonicalPairSchema.encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, and arrays preserved in declared order
canonicalPairSchema.typeNormalization: JVM binary name for declaring and reference types; primitive keyword for primitives; array dimensions preserved; generic arguments erased consistently for both proposal and gold
canonicalPairSchema.constructorNormalization: methodName is <init> and returnType is void
canonicalPairSchema.overloadRule: parameterTypes is an ordered array and is always present, including an empty array; overloads remain distinct
canonicalPairSchema.digest: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes

measurementContract.truePositive: one proposed canonical pair exactly matches one sealed necessary gold pair and its evidence independently satisfies the frozen evidence and role policy
measurementContract.falsePositive: a proposed pair is absent from gold, has wrong entity/action/role/polarity/condition, is ambiguous, lacks supporting evidence, or duplicates credit already assigned
measurementContract.falseNegative: a sealed necessary gold pair receives no valid one-to-one proposed match; an abstention does not remove it
measurementContract.classificationExhaustiveness: Within each repository and scenario, every proposed canonical pair is classified exactly once as TP or FP, and every sealed necessary gold pair is classified exactly once as matched or FN. Pair classification is complete before chain coverage is computed.
measurementContract.duplicatePolicy: At most one TP credit per gold pair. Every additional duplicate proposal is an FP.
measurementContract.abstentionPolicy: UNRESOLVED remains in scenario and gold denominators; necessary unmatched pairs are FN and abstentions are reported separately by reason.
measurementContract.zeroDenominatorPolicy: Return null with a machine-readable reason; never coerce to zero or one.
measurementContract.scenarioValidity: Every sealed selected scenario must have a unique canonical ID, repository snapshot binding, test/source provenance, one coverage stratum, and a sealed truth disposition. Missing or duplicate identity, bad provenance, schema failure, or digest failure makes the execution INVALID.

completeChainPolicy.identity: repositorySnapshotSha256 plus scenarioId plus the evaluator-sealed ordered array of canonical pair digests; chain order is not part of canonical pair identity and is used only for chain coverage
completeChainPolicy.requiredEdge: Each adjacent ordered METHOD pair must have evaluator-sealed source-backed call, dispatch, data-flow, or explicit necessary-method evidence under the frozen evidence policy.
completeChainPolicy.complete: Using the already classified one-to-one pair match set, every necessary pair and every required edge for the scenario is matched in evaluator-sealed chain order; extra unsupported pairs remain FP but do not erase correctly matched pair-level TPs.
completeChainPolicy.unsupportedOrUnresolved: Record an abstention reason and retain every necessary unmatched pair as FN; never remove the scenario or its truth from denominators.

coverage.scenarioCoverage: count of valid selected scenarios with at least one valid proposed pair divided by all sealed selected scenarios
coverage.completeChainCoverage: count of sealed selected scenarios whose complete necessary chain is matched divided by all sealed selected scenarios requiring a nonempty chain
coverage.unavailableDenominator: Return null with a machine-readable reason and classify INCONCLUSIVE only when eligibility/sample evidence was unavailable before execution; after execution, missing mandatory truth or malformed source/schema/digest evidence is INVALID.
coverage.passRequirement: Both coverage values and their raw numerators and denominators must be available for every repository; unavailable mandatory coverage prevents PASS.

measurementContract.confidenceIntervals: Report two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for precision and recall from unrounded counts; intervals are descriptive and do not replace the strict point-estimate gates.

aggregation.primaryDecision: Every repository must independently exceed both strict thresholds.
requiredReports: per-repository raw TP, FP, FN and metrics
micro aggregate from summed raw counts
abstentions, duplicates, unsupported inputs, invalid scenarios, and execution failures
aggregation.nonMaskingRule: No aggregate can hide or waive a repository that fails or has unavailable precision or recall.

roles.humanAuthority: Selects the sealed holdout and separately authorizes the one-shot execution; makes the terminal company-readiness decision.
roles.implementationActor: Freezes the final candidate before selection and has no selection or truth access.
roles.producer: Reads only approved source, test, scenario, structural evidence, runtime, and protocol inputs; never reads truth, proof ledger, expected pairs, or evaluator judgments.
roles.holdoutCustodian: Maintains the contamination ledger and evaluator-only selection artifact; does not implement or run the producer.
roles.truthAuthor: Authors truth from the sealed selected snapshots before generation and cannot alter producer artifacts.
roles.proofAuthor: Receives sealed producer outputs only after generation completion and writes evidence-to-gold decisions without filtering producer claims.
roles.scorerExecutor: Runs the sealed scorer exactly once after proof seal and cannot mutate truth, producer outputs, or proof ledger.
roles.independentReviewer: Recomputes manifests, counts, metrics, isolation, and the provisional decision from exact artifacts and was not an implementation, producer, truth, proof, or original scorer-execution actor.
roles.fdpOwner: Records the provisional classification and exact evidence revision without changing either.
roles.closureVerifier: Verifies the independent review and FDP receipt digests and seals the identical final holdout result; it cannot change the classification.

physicalControls: evaluator truth store unreadable by implementation and producer actors
producer outputs sealed before evaluator reveal
all cross-role transfers use digest manifests and receiver read-back

phaseGroups.attemptScope: The single-attempt execution and command ledger apply only to phases 4 through 6. Phase 7 verifies and classifies that immutable attempt. Phase 8 is outside the holdout execution and outside its command ledger.

executionPolicy.retryPolicy: No retry under the same holdout identity. Infrastructure or integrity failure invalidates and retires the selected set after preserving all evidence.
executionPolicy.stoppingRule: Complete pre-dispatch phases 1 through 3 before Human dispatch; run one-shot phases 4 through 6 without skipping or reordering; then run classification phase 7. Stop the one-shot execution immediately on nonzero exit, digest mismatch, isolation breach, output collision, resource violation, missing mandatory artifact or metric, or protocol deviation. Phase 8 is a later company-readiness decision.
immutability: all writable paths in the new immutable phase 4 through 7 execution namespace must be absent before phase 4; sealed read-only inputs and pre-dispatch receipts are outside that namespace
all failures, partial outputs, logs, ledgers, and manifests are preserved
no overwrite, repair, relabel, scenario replacement, threshold change, gold change, or score suppression
any post-result candidate, scorer, protocol, selection, scenario, truth, or threshold change permanently retires the selected data from formal holdout use

preReviewEvidenceBundle: selection receipt digest and independently verified reveal history
candidate, runtime, producer, scorer, protocol, source snapshot, scenario, truth, and proof digests
ordered command ledger and nonempty logs
sealed producer outputs for the final candidate for every repository
per-repository and aggregate raw counts, metrics, confidence intervals, coverage, abstentions, duplicates, unsupported inputs, and failures
classificationClosureBundle: independent recomputation and exact-run review with P0, P1, and P2 all zero
provisional result classification bound to the reviewed evidence digest
FDP receipt containing schema version, execution ID, exact evidence revision, identical result classification, acceptance status, and receipt SHA-256
closure-verifier receipt binding the review and FDP receipt digests
requiredOutputBundle.preResultClosureRule: Every preReviewEvidenceBundle item must exist and match its recorded digest before review. Phase 7 then creates and verifies every classificationClosureBundle item in order before the final result is sealed. Any post-dispatch missing item, digest mismatch, recomputation mismatch, or integrity failure is INVALID.
postHoldoutG6: separate Human GO, REVISE, or STOP company-readiness decision

classificationTable.postDispatchIntegrityOrMandatoryArtifact: INVALID; preserve evidence and retire the selected set

decisionPolicy.PASS: Every preReviewEvidenceBundle and classificationClosureBundle item is complete and verified, all integrity and mandatory coverage gates pass, every repository has available unrounded precision greater than 0.80 and recall greater than 0.60, and independent review has P0, P1, and P2 all zero.
decisionPolicy.REVISE: Integrity is valid but at least one repository fails either strict metric threshold.
decisionPolicy.INCONCLUSIVE: Before dispatch, mandatory eligibility, sample, permission, candidate, scorer, contamination, selection, truth, envelope, or review-preparation evidence is unavailable without an integrity breach. After dispatch, unavailable mandatory artifacts or metrics are INVALID.
decisionPolicy.INVALID: Any isolation, digest, role, attempt, ordering, immutability, or protocol-integrity rule fails.
decisionPolicy.companyReadinessBoundary: A formal holdout PASS is necessary but does not itself authorize deployment, publication, Product truth, or company use. Human Authority must review the complete G0-G5 bundle and issue the G6 terminal decision.
